In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the provided software codes can be used for exact evaluation of cumulative probabilities of relevant statistics on continuous genome IBD data.
, for the first time, a technology is provided for exact numerical evaluation of the distributions for statistics on continuous genome sequences for pairs of related individuals.
, for the considered statistics, a pair of full (half) sibs is the most informative pair of individuals, and a pair of (great-)grandchild with a (grand-)parent is the least informative.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the current biotechnology provides continuous data on genome segments and the current technology provides exact evaluation of distributions of relevant statistics on such data.

a technology is provided for rapid numerical evaluation, with arbitrary given accuracy, of cumulative probabilities of statistics associated with continuous IBD data, and therefore, a technology is provided to allow the evaluation of the p-values of tests for linkage analysis, based on statistics on continuous genome IBD data.
the current technology allows the rapid evaluation of the exact p-value for a given test, for any given data, without the use of any approximations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the distribution of statistics on continuous IDB data can be exactly evaluated for any pair of related individuals.
, for a pair of closely related individuals, the distributional theory for statistics on genome data may be developed for continuous genome data.
the distribution of the proportion of genome shared IBD on a chromosomal region, as well as the distribution of the number of subsegments with exactly 2 (1) IBD haplotypes, can be evaluated exactly.
